highlights: (%) 35.6 28.4 33.6 21.1 DPS (INR) 11.4 17.1 20.5 20.5 Yield (%) 0.1 0.2 0.2 0.2 RoE (%) 21.9 23.8 25.4 24.5 RoCE (%) 20.2 22.7 25.6 26.6 EV/Sales (x) 4.9 4.2 3.5 3.0 EV/EBITDA (x) 33.0 26.3 20.6 17.0 PE (x) 61.4 47.8 35.8 29.5 P/BV (x) 12.7 10.3 8.2 6.5 Strong show across segments Result Report Apollo Hospitals Enterprise (APHS)’ consolidated EBITDA improved 29% YoY to INR 11.9bn; in line with our estimates.
Adjusted for 24x7 losses and ESOPs cost (~INR910mn), EBITDA was at INR 12.8bn, up 22% YoY.
The management revised guidance of INR 15bn (earlier INR16.5-17.5bn) EBITDA of the merged entity by Q4FY27 (exit run-rate).

Further, mgmt. has also announced the demerger of its Omnichannel Pharmacy business, 24*7, and telehealth business into a newly listed entity with an aim to unlock value by creating a focused, high-growth platform in the pharmacy and digital healthcare space, which is more consumer centric in nature.

Having achieved the breakeven, the management aims to improve pharma unit economics by increasing daily orders by 20–30% over the next six months, targeting offline pharmacy-level margins initially at the pre-Opex level and subsequently at the EBITDA level.
